name: Quick Field Keys
description: Navigate and edit a designated layer with typed presets, field locks, feature Undo and explicit source Save.
author: HaYanJongSeong

commands.label: Undo Feature Edits
commands.params: {}: revert the last Quick Field Keys feature-edit group only; refuse changed values and locked fields; never writes source files

commands.label: Restore Previous Selection and View
commands.params: {}: restore the designated layer selection and camera without undoing feature edits

commands.label: Values
commands.params: {layer,identity,slot:1..9,field?,value?,null?:bool,unassign?:bool}: configure one slot without editing features; preserve other slots for the same target/identity

commands.label: Visible Columns
commands.params: {}: show or hide the column chooser; does not edit values

commands.label: Stage Column Choices
commands.params: {}: stage checkbox changes without applying them

commands.label: Apply Column Choices
commands.params: {}: apply and remember the displayed columns for this layer

commands.label: Cancel Column Choices
commands.params: {}: close without changing the displayed columns or saved preferences

commands.label: Save Layer to Source
commands.params: {}: immediately publish all pending edits of the designated layer, including edits from other tools, to its original local SHP/GeoJSON source; not project Save; external writes cannot be undone

commands.label: Options
commands.params: {identity?:text,reset-presets?:bool}: session-only identity guard; keyboard bindings remain in RustGIS Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts

form.name: identity
form.label: Unique identity field (blank keeps current)
form.help: For shortcut bindings use RustGIS Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts. The current SDK cannot open that editor from this panel.

form.name: reset-presets
form.label: Confirm clearing presets and locks when changing identity

items.help: Apply filter and refresh navigation. Keeps layer edits but clears plugin Undo history.

items.text: Choose a layer to prepare editing.

items.label: Previous selection / view
items.help: Restore the selection and map view from before the last navigation step. Keeps feature edits and the navigation filter. Unavailable after changing the target or projection.

items.label: Undo feature edits
items.help: Revert the last plugin edit group and reveal its feature. Consecutive edits to the same feature are grouped. Refuses external changes or locked fields. Session-only, limited to 4000 bytes; Save, target change and navigation reload clear the history. Does not undo other tools or saved source files.

items.label: = Values
items.help: Configure one preset slot without editing feature values.

items.label: 👁︎ Columns
items.help: Choose columns to show and edit for this layer. Hiding a column does not change its values or preset assignment.

items.label: 💾︎ Save
items.help: Immediately save all pending edits of the designated layer to its original local SHP/GeoJSON source. Includes edits from other tools; no confirmation dialog; external writes cannot be undone. Not project Save.

items.label: ⚙ Options
items.help: Configure the identity guard. Keyboard bindings use RustGIS Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts; direct opening is not supported by the SDK.

items.text: Choose columns, then Apply or Cancel. Only column names are remembered; values and presets are unchanged.
Press Save to apply changes to the original file.
